featured_reviews.review_text:
Attended their 8pm show tonight. It was largely funny and entertaining. Kudos to the performers! Just a couple of points:

1. I was laughing loudly at the first stand up comedian's act, but being a yogi, I sometimes enter silent spaces within myself- so was quieter after a while, within his performance. And the stand up comic started picking on me in a big way. He asked me if I was okay because I wasn't laughing- I told him, I am okay, its just that I am a yogi so I become quiet after a while. He just thought that I i didn't like his act and kept commenting on the yogic posture I was sitting in, my shawl, saying that I have 'south mumbai' confidence in a derogatory way, started making jokes indirectly about me. Then I also pushed back and told him that he was making some offensive jokes about handicapped people etc. I did get that he was just trying to be funny- but he just woudn't stop picking on me- though, I was laughing at all his jokes largely. Its one thing to engage and interact with your audience- its another to be downright offensive- specially when the stand up comic himself can't take the pushback from us. I am a yogi-so I didn't let this disturb me- but this is not how an entertaining night should be. He ended his act by saying that his friend who did Vipassana (the silence program) can't stop talking about it and how its an oxymoron. See, you are totally entitled to your opinion- but sometimes comics will just keep pushing and pushing the audience members, though they have paid for your program and are there for a happy evening out. In fact the comic said to me that I was messing with the audience's good time this evening- because I pointed out that some of his jokes were offensive- which I did only because he wouldn't stop throwing his jibes at me. I think that you guys can do better than this please.

2. The stand up comedians displayed on their poster on bookmyshow- are very popular, well known names- none of whom were there tonight. It is mentioned on their poster in a not very legible font that the final lineup may or maynot feature those popular comics. But that is a very very easy to miss point- on their poster. However, most comics tonight were still good and the show was entertaining overall

I wish them the very best for their endevours!
